name: Axfood AB
sector: Consumer Staples / food retail and wholesale
businessSummary: Swedish food retailer: Willys, Hemkop, City Gross (retail) and Dagab, Snabbgross (wholesale). Roughly 90bn SEK sales; operating margin about 4%.

price.note: Latest price retrievable; stale versus 2026-11-13. Agent data did not contain AXFO.

enterpriseValue.source: derived: mcap 59,040 + net debt incl. leases 16,294

peForward.note: Consensus EPS 2026 11.67, 2027 12.99 (stockanalysis, S&P, page updated 2026-07-10, before Q3). FY2027E P/E 21.1.

evEbitTrailing.note: EBIT TTM = FY2025 3,611 + 9M26 2,888 - 9M25 2,712. Operating profit is EBIT (reported); adjusted 9M26 2,903. Using EV excl. leases (62,010) gives 16.4 but is inconsistent with IFRS 16 EBIT.

evEbitdaTrailing.note: EV excl. leases / EBITDA excl. IFRS 16 (4,944) = 12.5.

fcfTTM.note: Pre-lease FCF 4,368 (stockanalysis shows this as FCF, yield 7.8%, which overstates cash available to equity because IFRS 16 lease payments of ~2.5bn are financing outflows). FY2025: OCF 6,751, capex 1,379, leases 2,478 -> 2,894 after leases.

payoutRatio.note: Policy at least 50%. Stockanalysis shows 79.8% on TTM. Dividends (1,943 in 9M26) exceed FCF after leases (about 1.9bn TTM).

netDebtToEbitda.note: Excl. IFRS 16: 0.6x. Year-end 2025: 1.9x incl / 0.4x excl. Up over 9M (seasonal/VAT-related working capital).

roic.note: Company reports ROCE not ROIC; 15.5% at YE2025. Stockanalysis ROIC 13.0%.

roe.note: 32.1% at YE2025. Inflated by low equity/high payout.

likeForLike.note: Market retail growth 4.0% in Q3; Axfood retail sales +2.9% (Willys +2.1%, Hemkop +7.1%): losing share at Willys.

sectorMetrics.investmentGuidance2026: 2,000-2,100 (cut from 2,200-2,300; about 270 shifted to 2027 due to Kungsbacka automation delay)

history.source: stockanalysis.com (EBIT = operating profit; FCF pre-lease, lease payments 1,578)
derived from reports; 9M26 net sales 67,504 (66,321), op profit 2,888 (2,712). TTM Jun 2026 per stockanalysis: revenue 89,911, EBIT 3,714, margin 4.13%, FCF 4,368 pre-lease

consensus.source: stockanalysis.com/forecast (rating counts Oct 2026, targets page updated 2026-07-10; may be stale). Avg target is below the 273.50 price.

recentEvents: Q3 2026 (22 Oct): net sales 22,711 (+1.9%), op profit 1,118 (1,059), adj 1,119 (1,099), EPS 3.47 (3.30); LFL +1.6%; City Gross turned profitable.
2026 investment guidance cut to 2,000-2,100; City Gross structural costs now about 25 (was 50).
Q1 2026 (23 Apr): CEO said growth lower than desired; Kepler cut target 340 to 315; Bernstein Sell 235 (10 Jul).
Dividend 9.00 paid in two instalments of 4.50.
valueTrapFlags: Like-for-like growth only +1.6% in Q3 vs market growth 4.0%; Willys LFL +0.3% (share loss).
EBIT margin stuck about 4.0-4.5% for 5 years with no expansion; 9M26 4.3% only modestly up.
FCF after IFRS 16 lease payments is thin (about 1.9bn TTM) versus 1.9bn dividends paid in 9M26; payout above 80% of EPS.
Leverage incl. leases rose to 2.1x from 1.9x at YE2025 (0.6x excl. leases).
Price above average analyst target; consensus not cut after Q3 but sources stale.
dataGaps: Prices are 2026-10-19, not 2026-11-13; agent data lacks AXFO
Consensus EPS after Q3 report and revision direction
TTM Sep 2026 revenue and lease payments
Q3 operating cash flow was 1,956 (1,352); 9M 4,270 (4,513) per report, lease payments 9M not read

valuation.method: Next-12m EPS x justified P/E. Basis 2026E EPS 11.7 (consensus 11.67 pre-Q3, TTM 11.38). Price is the 2026-10-19 close (stale). Historical multiple ranges not verified by agents; justified multiples are lead estimates.

bear.note: Continued market-share loss, margin pressure. Justified multiple 18x on next-12m 11.82.

base.note: Low-single-digit growth, stable 4% margin. Justified multiple 21x on next-12m 12.17.

bull.note: Willys regains share, City Gross profitable. Justified multiple 24x on next-12m 12.40.

valuation.whyItFits: Swedish grocery leader (Willys, Hemköp): low beta 0.56, non-cyclical demand, 3.3% dividend.
valuation.growthDrivers: Willys discount format, City Gross turnaround, logistics investments.
valuation.saturation: P/E 24 for 4% growth and consensus target below the price: fully valued.
valuation.principalRisk: Losing share (like-for-like +1.6% vs market +4.0%) while dividends roughly equal FCF after leases.
